# Profile designs (fixture, text description of 6 exported images)

Requirements: a user can view and edit their profile name and photo. Saving can fail.

- img_01.png: "Profile": photo, name "Asha Rao", button "Edit".
- img_02.png: "Profile edit": name field filled, "Change photo", buttons "Save" and "Cancel".
- img_03.png: "Profile edit": identical to img_02.png (same layout, same content, same state).
- img_04.png: "Profile edit - error": same as img_02.png with banner "Couldn't save changes. Try again."
- img_05.png: "Profile edit (1)": same layout as img_02.png but the name field is empty and "Save" is disabled.
- img_06.png: "Profile - saved": photo, updated name, toast "Profile updated".
